title: T-1 typed put get delete list verbs with metadata field pattern realise the Workers KV binding shape behind the facade
description: T-1 typed put get delete list realise the Workers KV binding shape behind the facade. put(key, value, {ttl, metadata}) writes with expirationTtl and metadata to the binding; get(key) returns null on miss; getWithMetadata(key) returns {value, metadata}; delete(key) is idempotent; list({prefix, limit, cursor}) paginates keys with metadata shape intact per the Cloudflare KV binding contract at https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/api/. Metadata is a JSON-serialisable object; the shipped default metadata field pattern is {v: number} (elicited).
